source_text: Congregata omni congregatione in Silo — ibi tabernaculum. Pax (Silo) locus sortium. Ecclesia in pace Christi sortes spiritales accipit.
pass_a_gloss: Gathered with-all congregation in Shiloh — there tabernacle. Peace (Shiloh) place of-lots. Church in peace of-Christ lots spiritual receives.
pass_b_english: [[All the congregation gathers at Shiloh — the tent of meeting there >> Bible:Joshua 18:1]]. Shiloh (“peace”) is the place of lots. The church in Christ’s peace receives spiritual lots.
